seed_policy: Deterministic per-anchor seed reused for concise/verbose and before/after; does not guarantee identical outputs across platforms
pilot_acceptance: All nine within approved ranges, valid literal support and coherent checks; stop at first failure
full_acceptance: Unchanged 38 valid, >=18/20 range matches, zero bad accepted at 4-5, six mitigated pairs difference <=1, plus no internal inconsistencies in criteria checks; quoted evidence must be literal and from cited chunks
final_validation_requires: Independent confirmation with reviewed new examples plus human audit of concise evidence-based reasons
independence_limit: Same Qwen family as system generator, but different generation/checkpoint; not full independence
reasoning_retention: Do not retain or display private thinking text; record token counts/hashes and unedited final JSON only
causality_limit: Model, judgement protocol and decoding changed together; do not attribute any gain to a single factor
